title: Static Four Spread Fin and Unequal Tail Flying Fish
description: One wholly newly authored stylised flying-fish-like static exterior: long narrow fusiform head and trunk, two broad swept winglike pectoral fins plus a distinct smaller rear pair of extended pelvic fins, small aft dorsal fin and vertically forked tail with a distinctly longer lower lobe. Small lateral eyes and a finite lower trunk display patch complete the whole fish. Not an old ordinary fish with scaled fins or a ray disc with a different tail; every axial section and complete fin outline is new. One model zero scenes. Opaque illustrative surfaces, no biological fin-ray texture or translucency; no species accuracy, gliding, flight, swimming, buoyancy, ecological behaviour, physical resting balance, rig or animation claim.
